qualification: One handwritten assertion-bearing candidate, source/static evidence only. Independent review receipt determines census credit. Runtime status stays NOT_RUN until separate observed execution.
oracle_policy: All expected bytes/statuses are fixed literals; snapshots precede later mutation. Source implementation is never the expected-value oracle.
ordinary_input_scope: One valid local four-byte default-stream Response. No native HTTP body, RPC, remote handle, capability, scheduler, malformed input or security/lifetime reproduction.

cases.title: Keep cloned raw body chunks independent after sibling mutation
cases.mechanism: Response body clone requests branch-two chunk storage copying before raw-reader mutation
cases.hypothesis: A streaming clone implemented with default tee() can return shared raw Uint8Array storage even when final arrayBuffer consumers each return copied bytes.
trace: Enqueue one four-byte Uint8Array into an ordinary default ReadableStream and close.
Clone the local Response once and acquire both body readers.
Join both first reads and assert exact initial bytes.
Mutate the original raw chunk; assert its changed bytes, unchanged sibling bytes and distinct backing buffers.
Join both EOF reads, join cleanup cancellation operations and release explicit readers.
cases.distinctness: Y220 observes only final copied arrayBuffers; Y215 observes buffered clone output and metadata. This case observes live raw branch chunks after mutation, proving the tee-true selection has an observable effect. One mechanism only; no parameterized variants.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.deep(first.map(result => result.status), ['fulfilled', 'fulfilled'], 'both initial raw reads fulfill before mutation');
t.deep(first.map(result => result.value.done), [false, false], 'one deliberate source chunk reaches each branch');
t.deep(first.map(result => result.value.value instanceof Uint8Array), [true, true], 'both raw chunks are Uint8Array values');
t.deep([...left], [10, 20, 30, 40], 'original raw chunk has the fixed source bytes');
t.deep([...right], [10, 20, 30, 40], 'clone raw chunk has the fixed source bytes');
t.deep([...left], [99, 20, 30, 40], 'raw original chunk mutation takes effect locally');
t.deep([...right], [10, 20, 30, 40], 'raw clone chunk retains its bytes after sibling mutation');
t.equal(left.buffer === right.buffer, false, 'raw branch chunks use distinct ArrayBuffer storage');
t.deep(eof.map(result => result.status), ['fulfilled', 'fulfilled'], 'both EOF reads fulfill before cleanup');
t.deep(eof.map(result => result.value.done), [true, true], 'each branch reaches EOF immediately after its single chunk');
t.deep(eof.map(result => result.value.value === undefined), [true, true], 'both terminal reads contain no extra value');
cases.application_relevance: Worker code can inspect or transform one cloned local binary response body through raw readers without changing its sibling consumer data.
cases.desired_behavior: Initial chunks [10,20,30,40] on both branches; after left[0]=99, left [99,20,30,40], right [10,20,30,40], distinct backing ArrayBuffers, then EOF on both.
cases.chunk_partition_contract: A deliberately single default-stream chunk, not a byte stream/host body. Default tee forwards one chunk (or structured clone) to each branch, without arbitrary HTTP coalescing assumptions.
cases.source_observation: Candidate001 refuses the valid streaming clone. Candidate002 r002 calls existing tee(true), whose default-stream branch copies branch two with structuredClone. This is source evidence only.
preconditions: Independent case/oracle review and separate exact candidate source/build/deployment review.
Real celld Response and ReadableStream globals; no imported/extracted SUT or reference runtime.
External five-second request and independent suite/cleanup deadlines plus owned teardown and resource controls are verified before entry.

schedule.parallelism: two branch reads joined at data and EOF phases; all cleanup cancellations started before their join

cases.cleanup: Join all started reads before cleanup; initiate all reader and unlocked-stream cancels before awaiting; release both acquired readers; require terminal evidence for all tracked streams and both-descendant proof for retained source lock. Pending operation at external deadline => UNKNOWN and incomplete local cleanup. Verified external listener closure, whole proven-owned dev/bundler/runtime descendant-tree emptiness across PGIDs, and owned temporary/log/stage/store removal required for acceptance.
